title: Emergency water fixture.
officialText:
Fixtures capable of supplying an emergency source of potable water in accordance with this
section shall consist of a faucet conforming to Section PC 424 or a fixture conforming to Section PC 424 that is capable of attaching to a splitter either:
1. a sink conforming to Section PC 418; or
2. a floor drain conforming to Section PC 412.
